title: Platform process supervisor spawn plan
description: A typed spawn plan. It names an approved executable profile, never a command string, interpreter invocation, executable path, or script body. Arguments are an already-separated bounded array, the environment is a closed allowlist, and the working directory is a typed role. Shell interpolation, command chaining, redirection, metacharacter payloads, registry commands, privilege escalation, raw file descriptors, and raw signal values are structurally unrepresentable. This contract does not spawn anything.

executable_digest.description: Digest of the exact approved executable the profile resolves to, so a supervisor can refuse a substituted binary.

arguments.description: Already-separated argument array. It is never joined into a command line and never interpreted by a shell.

environment_allowlist.description: Closed allowlist entries. An arbitrary environment dictionary cannot be expressed.

inherit_parent_environment.description: Always false in a reviewed plan: a packaged process must not inherit an interactive-shell environment.
